name: Growing Apart From Yuika
source:
After a breakup and a lot of consoling sessions, you received a text from Yuika.

You read that Yuika has something to say.

You agreed to meet at your usual hangout spots.

What could this be about?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4184500/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在分手和多次安慰之后，你收到了尤伊卡的短信。

你读到尤伊卡有话要说。

你们同意在你们常去的地方见面。

这可能是关于什么的？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4184500/]Steam[/url]]
